body.statement: In the explicitly two-dimensional observation experiment \(Z^{\mathrm{sw}}\), the minimum over all confidence kernels \(K:\mathbb R^2\rightsquigarrow2^{\{0,\Delta\}}\) satisfying \(\min_{\ell\in\{0,1\}}\Pr_{\ell}\{\ell\Delta\in K(Z^{\mathrm{sw}})\}\ge1-\alpha\) of \(\max_{\ell\in\{0,1\}}\mathbb E_{\ell}[\operatorname{diam}(K(Z^{\mathrm{sw}}))]\) is \(r_2(c,\Delta,\alpha)=\Delta[\Phi(z_{1-\alpha}-\sqrt2c)-\alpha]_+\). The rule \(C^{\mathrm{NP}}_{c,\Delta,\alpha}\) attains this value, including the zero-overlap regime. Under the \(J=2\), \(q=1\) panel submodel with \(b=(0,\Delta)^{\top}\), \(L_{\mathrm{sw}}\Omega L_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\top}=I_2\), and state-invariant independent \(U^{\mathrm{sw}}\), the full observation \(Z^{\mathrm{pan}}\) is equivalent to the switch experiment augmented by an ancillary variable, so the same minimax value and rule apply.
body.justification: The closed form identifies the exact price of honest adaptation at the smallest nontrivial donor collision and supplies the base case for the general dual program.
body.gap: Evans, Hansen, and Stark give a general Bayes--minimax confidence-set duality, and Cai and Low give modulus lower bounds; neither solves this discontinuous two-face causal target.
body.consumer: The formula is an exact calibration benchmark for any simultaneous or conditional donor-selection interval.
